rows.title: Radisson Blu Bariloche
rows.body:
Resort, Argentina, CALA, Lakeside, Upper upscale

San Carlos de Bariloche, Río Negro, Argentina (Lake Nahuel Huapi)

New-build / opening · upper-upscale · lake and mountain leisure

Opened in 2025 on Nahuel Huapi—a lakeside upper-upscale hotel with Nordic Nouveau public spaces, wellness, and outdoor-adventure positioning in the Andes. Choice positioned it as the brand’s Argentina entry for Radisson Blu.

You might compare this format if you are underwriting resort leisure in CALA: design-forward public spaces, seasonal demand, and Choice Privileges retail—not mainstream Radisson conversion economics.

If you are looking at resort leisure in the Andes, plan for strong seasonality and full F&B/wellness investment—opening photos do not replace local occupancy patterns.

https://www.choicehotels.com/argentina/san-carlos-de-bariloche/radisson-blu-hotels
rows.caseSummaryOverview: Bariloche, Argentina: Radisson Blu on Lake Nahuel Huapi—2025 opening described as Choice’s first Radisson Blu in Argentina, in an Andes leisure destination.

rows.caseSummaryBrandRelevance: Helpful reference for resort or mixed leisure upper-upscale in CALA when Nordic Nouveau investment is in scope.
rows.caseSummaryInterpretation: Lake and mountain seasons swing occupancy—budget F&B and wellness for your market’s peak and shoulder months, not only on opening headlines.

rows.title: Radisson Blu Aruba
rows.body:
Resort, Caribbean, CALA, Beachfront, Upper upscale

Palm Beach, Aruba

Resort upper-upscale · beach and rooftop pool · leisure compression

Radisson Blu Aruba on Palm Beach offers beach access, dining, and an adults-only rooftop pool—upper-upscale leisure for North American and regional guests under Choice-affiliated distribution.

If you are evaluating resort Blu, compare public-space investment, F&B scope, and loyalty-led leisure retail to other Palm Beach supply—not core Radisson extended-stay economics.

Resort Blu here is about beach retail and leisure compression—confirm fees, seasonality, and who operates F&B for your parcel, not just brand positioning.

https://www.choicehotels.com/aruba/palm-beach/radisson-blu-hotels/aw007
rows.caseSummaryOverview: Palm Beach, Aruba: Radisson Blu resort upper-upscale on the beach strip—leisure from regional and North American demand.
rows.caseSummaryOwnerObjective: Monetize beachfront leisure with distinctive public spaces and upper-upscale rate potential.
rows.caseSummaryBrandRelevance: Reference for Caribbean CALA resort Blu versus Brazilian or Chilean urban hotels.
rows.caseSummaryInterpretation: Beach hotels on this strip compete on seasonality and fees—check year-round demand for your site before you assume Palm Beach results from one hotel.

rows.title: Radisson Blu Belo Horizonte, Savassi
rows.body:
Urban, Brazil, CALA, Meetings, Upper upscale

Belo Horizonte, Minas Gerais, Brazil (Savassi)

Upper-upscale urban · meetings and F&B · corporate and leisure

Radisson Blu Belo Horizonte, Savassi serves Brazil’s third-largest metro with upper-upscale rooms, meetings-capable public spaces, and Savassi-district access.

The flag sits above core Radisson in the portfolio: plan for Nordic Nouveau casegoods, full-service F&B, and gallery-curator service—not a lighter conversion box.

Secondary-city Blu needs meetings and full-service F&B—confirm local demand, fees, and operator capability for your asset before you commit.

https://www.choicehotels.com/minas-gerais/belo-horizonte/radisson-blu-hotels/br154
rows.caseSummaryOverview: Belo Horizonte, Savassi: Radisson Blu upper-upscale urban hotel—meetings and F&B for corporate and leisure mix.
rows.caseSummaryOwnerObjective: Win urban commercial and group demand with recognizable upper-upscale design and portfolio loyalty.
rows.caseSummaryBrandRelevance: Shows Blu in a Brazilian secondary city versus São Paulo gateway or resort formats.
rows.caseSummaryInterpretation: In a secondary city, Blu works when meetings and F&B are real—match Savassi-style demand and operator strength to your building before you sign.

rows.title: Radisson Blu São Paulo
rows.body:
Urban gateway, Brazil, CALA, Corporate, Upper upscale

São Paulo, Brazil (Cidade Jardim corridor)

Upper-upscale urban · meetings · corporate and international demand

Radisson Blu São Paulo targets corporate transient, international arrivals, and groups in Brazil’s primary business hub—with Nordic Nouveau positioning and Choice Privileges in a dense competitive set.

Compare Blu to other international upper-upscale flags when your asset can support signature F&B, meetings, and casegoods—not when the building fits core Radisson conversion scope.

For a gateway urban asset, your economics depend on corporate/group mix, parking, and nearby international supply—use local comps, not U.S. suburban Blu assumptions.

https://www.choicehotels.com/sao-paulo/sao-paulo/radisson-blu-hotels
rows.caseSummaryOverview: São Paulo: Radisson Blu in a top CALA business market—corporate, group, and international transient with full upper-upscale expectations.
rows.caseSummaryOwnerObjective: Capture corporate, group, and international demand with upper-upscale public spaces and meetings product.
rows.caseSummaryBrandRelevance: Benchmark Blu against international upper-upscale competitors in São Paulo.
rows.caseSummaryInterpretation: São Paulo gateways live on corporate, group, and international mix—not a U.S. suburban template—build your budget from local contracts, parking, and your comp set.

rows.title: Radisson Blu Plaza El Bosque Santiago
rows.body:
Urban, Chile, CALA, Business district, Meetings

Santiago, Chile (Las Condes / El Bosque corridor)

Upper-upscale downtown · meetings and group · Chile capital

Radisson Blu Plaza El Bosque Santiago serves Santiago’s financial corridor with upper-upscale rooms, meetings product, and public spaces for corporate transient, groups, and international arrivals.

Strong reference for urban Chile: meetings pipeline, parking, and international competition matter more than lifestyle marketing alone—confirm fees and operator group capability before LOI.

Urban Chile hinges on groups, parking, and international competition—confirm meetings capability and fees on your deal before you use industry averages.
